tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'od gsal snying po bzhugs so/ / 'od gsal snying po zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos sku byang chub spraus dang bral ba'i klong*/ /ye nas lhun grub mngon par 'dus ma byas/ /gdod ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba la/ /rlung rig rnam par dag pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhi las gdangs shar lam du mngon snang ba/ /mi 'gyur mnyam pa'i gzer chen btab pa yis/ /gdod ma'i dbyings su zad ba'i sar phyin pa/ /ji ltar bdag gis rtogs bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /nyi zlas brgyan pa'i rin chen khang pa na/ /'od gsal rdo rje snying po mchog bzhugs pas// ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum nyid de/ /stong gsal rig pa'i snying por lhun gyis grub/ /gdangs gsum ngang las rig pa'i gnas tshul ni/ /ngo bo skur gnas chos sku stong pa'i gdangs/ /dran bsam spros dang bral ba'i tshe na mngon// rang bzhin 'od gnas lhun grub gting gsal gdangs/ /dbyings snang kha dog phyir gsal tshe na mngon/ / thugs rje rig gnas 'char tshul ma 'gags gdangs/ /shar grol ris med rang yal tshe na mngon/ /phyi gsal de bzhin nyid du 'ang de bzhin te/ /rtsa rnams nang na gdangs gsum rang snang bas/ /nang gi shes pa stong dang gsal dang 'gyu/ /rang bzhin ngang du bltas tshe mngon pa yin// de nyid don la ji lta bsgoms pa yang*/ /lta stangs gzigs stangs rlung sems dal ba yis/ /mi g.yo gsum ldan rlung rig mkha' la gtad/ /rang la snang ba 'od kyi ra ba na/ /rig gdangs rgyal po rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /'gul 'phrigs med par btson du bzung bar bya/ /de tshe rang rig gdangs gsum rang gsal bzhugs/ /ngo bo'i gdangs la stong gsal dmigs 'dzin med/ /rang bzhin rang gdangs dbyings rigs rang ngor gsal/ /thugs rje'i rig gdangs shar grol gnyen po zhig /rang yal rjes med ngang la gnas pa yin/ / gdangs gsum du

sa gcig rten 'brel mthun pa'i tshe/ /rang byung 'od gsal dgongs klongayangs pa yin/ /phyi ru snang ba'i rang gdangs snang ba'i tshe/ /nang du rig pa ka dag chos zad klong*/ /dran rtog yid la byed pa'i chos med par/ /mkha' bzhin mi rtog rgyal ba'i dgongs par gnas/ /rlung sems rang dag snang ba 'dzin med gsal/ /'di ni thod rgal snying po'i man ngag yin/ / dge bas 'gro kun 'od lus dag par shog /'od gsal sny-ing po zhes bya ba/ / theg pa rgyal po'i rnal 'byor pa/ sna tshogs rang grol gyis gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du sbyar ba rdzogs so// //dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ zab mo yang tig 'od gsal snying po/ -PAGE 196-- PAGE 195 - -PAGE 194-
